name: Orkla ASA
sector: Consumer Defensive / Packaged foods and branded consumer goods
businessSummary: Nordic branded consumer goods group (Orkla Foods, Snacks, Care, Health, Orkla India, Food Ingredients, House Care) plus a 42.7% stake in paint maker Jotun (associate). Hydro Power sold in 2025.

price.note: NOK. After Q3 beat on 6 Nov 2026.

netDebt.note: Provider: total debt 22.67bn less cash 1.45bn; lease treatment not stated. Company NIBD at FY2025: NOK 14,167m incl. leases / 11,879m excl. leases. Rise vs FY2025 not reconciled (buybacks, acquisition, special dividend).

enterpriseValue.note: Derived: market cap ~100.9bn + net debt 21.2bn = ~NOK 122.1bn (provider EV 115.52bn at lower price). Excludes value of Jotun stake adjustment.

peTrailing.note: Provider figure; stockanalysis showed 14.38 at ~94.4 on 2026-10-16 (TTM EPS 7.10). FY2025 adjusted diluted EPS 6.83 gives 15.4x at 104.90.

peForward.note: Provider figure at 2026-10-16 price; would be ~15.9x at 104.90 if estimates unchanged.

evEbitTrailing.note: Provider figure; implied EBIT (~9.5bn) exceeds reported EBIT (TTM 7.3bn), so likely includes associates/Jotun. Company EBIT (adj.) FY2025 7,647m is EBIT (adj.), not EBITA. Derived on company numbers: EV 122.1bn / 7,647m = ~16.0x (FY2025 EBIT (adj.), current price).

evEbitdaTrailing.note: Provider figure; stockanalysis showed 9.62 on 2026-10-16. Large conflict between providers, not reconciled.

fcfTTM.note: Provider definition. Company cash flow before capital allocation FY2025 6,945m (FY2024 6,970m); provider FY2025 FCF 6,720m.

fcfYield.note: Derived: 6,658 / ~100,880 = ~6.6% (provider showed 7.29% at the lower Oct price). Dividend NOK 6.00 x 962m = ~5.8bn, covered ~1.15x.

dividendPerShare.note: Intention to propose; May 2025 payment was NOK 10.00 incl. NOK 6.00 additional.

payoutRatio.note: Agent figure; stockanalysis 86.4% (2026-10-16). Conflict: bases differ. On FY2025 adjusted EPS 6.83 dividend 6.00 = 88%.

netDebtToEbitda.note: Company: NIBD 14,167m incl. leases. Agent shows 2.45 (2026-11-12); provider-implied ~1.8 (21.2bn / ~12.0bn EBITDA). Conflict unresolved; latest company figure is FY2025. Q3 2026 company figure not retrieved.

interestCoverage.note: Provider value 9.22 is identical to its ROIC value and is treated as unreliable.

sectorMetrics.operatingProfitDefinition: Company headline measure is EBIT (adj.), not EBITA. EPS: company reports diluted EPS and adjusted diluted EPS.
portfolioChanges: Hydro Power sold 2025 (~NOK 5.5bn proceeds), reported as discontinued; FY2025 EPS 11.48 includes a NOK 5,120m discontinued profit; 2024 restated.
Pierre Robert Group sold Q1 2025 (accounting loss NOK 47m); Lilleborg divested; 2024 revenue not comparable.
Orkla India IPO Nov 2025: 15% sold (net NOK 1.5bn), Orkla owns 75%.
Two Icelandic Orkla Food Ingredients businesses sold (NOK 432m).
Acquisitions FY2025 NOK 592m (Eurohansa Torun, Le Vesuve, Decorgel); Sept 2026 Orkla Snacks completed The European Candy Group (for BUBS).
Capital Markets Day 1 Dec 2026 will set 2030 targets.
sectorMetrics.buybacks: Up to NOK 4bn programme started Sep 2026 running to 31 Dec 2027 at the latest (Q3 2026 release); the earlier NOK 4bn programme (from 17 Nov 2025, to 31 Dec 2026) had NOK 841m executed in 2025 (NOK 1.2bn total buybacks in 2025).
sectorMetrics.forexNote: Stronger NOK reduced reported Q3 revenue and EBIT; underlying growth strips FX and portfolio effects.

history.source: stockanalysis.com (NOK m; reported operating income, EPS, FCF). Not restated for later divestments/Hydro Power.

Orkla Q4 2025 report: revenue, reported EBIT (restated for Hydro Power as discontinued), adjusted diluted EPS 6.06 (reported diluted 6.06 incl. disc. ops; continuing 5.70), cash flow before capital allocation 6,970. EBIT (adj.) 7,142. Provider shows op. income 6,979, FCF 7,616.

Orkla Q4 2025 report: reported EBIT 7,086 (EBIT adj. 7,647); EPS = adjusted diluted 6.83 (reported diluted 11.48 incl. Hydro Power gain; continuing 6.38); cash flow before capital allocation 6,945. Provider op. income 7,463, FCF 6,720.

recentEvents: 6 Nov 2026 Q3: organic growth 3.1% (volume/mix 2.7%), EBIT (adj.) NOK 2,078m (+1.9%, ~6.5% above consensus 1,951m), margin 11.8%, adjusted EPS NOK 1.94 (+4.9%); underlying EBIT (adj.) +8.1%.
Reported Q3 operating revenues NOK 17.5bn, -2.3% YoY (stronger NOK, portfolio changes) despite +3.1% organic.
Jotun Q3 profit NOK 563m, -6.6% (sales +13%, operating profit +1.3% adjusted for FX).
New share buyback up to NOK 4bn from Sep 2026 to 31 Dec 2027.
Orkla Snacks completed The European Candy Group acquisition (Sep 2026).
Capital Markets Day on 1 Dec 2026: new targets to 2030.
valueTrapFlags: Reported revenue declined 2.3% in Q3 and reported EBIT -3.1% while adjusted metrics rose; gap from FX, comparability and other income/expense items.
Organic growth only 3.1% (volume/mix 2.7%); EBIT (adj.) +1.9% reported, with the beat driven by margin (11.8% vs 11.4%).
Jotun earnings (a large share of profit before tax: NOK 2,181m associate profit in FY2025) fell 6.6% in Q3.
Leverage drifting up: company NIBD/EBITDA 1.4x at FY2025, but provider net debt NOK 21.2bn at Q3 2026 vs NOK 14.2bn at FY2025 and agent ND/EBITDA 2.45; unreconciled.
Dividend NOK 6.00 is ~88% of FY2025 adjusted EPS (payout 61% to 86% depending on source) and the FY2025 EPS includes a one-off Hydro Power gain.
After the 11% run since mid-October the stock trades at ~15.9x trailing P/E near consensus mean target 110.25 (analyst rating hold).
dataGaps: Q3 2026 net debt, NIBD/EBITDA, cash flow and YTD figures (full Q3 report PDF not accessed); no explicit guidance.

valuation.method: Next-12m EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E adjusted EPS NOK 7.2 (FY2025 continuing 6.83, Q3 EBIT adj. beat; lead estimate). Portfolio changes reduce history comparability. Capital Markets Day 1 Dec 2026.

bear.note: Branded volumes stall, Jotun weakens. Justified multiple 13x on next-12m 7.34.

base.note: Organic 3%, margin gains from portfolio focus, buybacks. Justified multiple 16x on next-12m 7.63.

bull.note: New 2030 targets credible, Jotun and India grow. Justified multiple 18x on next-12m 7.78.

valuation.whyItFits: Nordic branded consumer goods: beta 0.2, 5.7% dividend, about 6.6% FCF yield, NOK 4bn buyback, ND/EBITDA 1.4x.
valuation.growthDrivers: Portfolio-company model, price/mix, Jotun stake, Orkla India listing value, buybacks.
valuation.saturation: P/E 16 trailing: reasonably valued for a defensive staples group; consensus target slightly above price (analyst opinion).
valuation.principalRisk: Low ROIC (about 9%, near cost of capital) and reported revenue declines from FX and divestments.
